title: AP Precalculus 2.7 — Composition of Functions
question: Composite functions from formulas and tables, the cost of a car trip and the domain of a composition.
intro:
**Quick recap:**

- Composition:

\[
(f\circ g)(x)=f\big(g(x)\big)
\]

- Work from the inside out: first \(g(x)\), then use that output as the input of \(f\).
- Order matters: \(f\big(g(x)\big)\) and \(g\big(f(x)\big)\) are usually different.
- Domain of \(f\big(g(x)\big)\): the \(x\) for which \(g(x)\) is a valid input of \(f\).

**A calculator is allowed. Show your calculation before choosing A–D.**

questions.title: Formulas · Evaluate a composition
Table · Composition from a table
questions.solution_title: Read g first, then use its output in f

questions.title: Formulas · Build f(g(x))
questions.prompt:
Let

\[
f(x)=3x-2
\]

and

\[
g(x)=x^2
\]

Which expression is \(f\big(g(x)\big)\)?
questions.solution_title: Replace every x in f with g(x)

questions.title: Fuel · Cost of a trip
questions.prompt:
A car uses

\[
L(m)=0.06m
\]

litres of fuel to drive \(m\) km.

Fuel costs

\[
C(L)=1.7L
\]

euros for \(L\) litres.

Use \(C\big(L(m)\big)\) to find the fuel cost of a \(250\) km trip.

questions.title: Domain · Square root of 6 − x
questions.prompt:
Let

\[
f(x)=\sqrt{x}
\]

and

\[
g(x)=6-x
\]

What is the domain of \(f\big(g(x)\big)\)?
questions.solution_title: The output of g must be in the domain of f

takeaway: In a composition the output of the inside function is the input of the outside function, so the order matters.
